_comment: Infrastructure inventory (PORT-01 / INFRA-01). Owned by INFRASTRUCTURE (reports to ENGINEERING; standing dev member of the Growth and Capacity Review). scripts/infra-register.mjs reads this plus the code and writes docs/engineering/INFRASTRUCTURE_REGISTER.md; `pnpm infra:register:check` fails when the code uses a dependency, server function, API route, environment variable, bucket or database extension that no entry here claims, or when the register is out of date. Plans, prices and regions are owner-reported or unverified unless a dated source says otherwise.

services.name: Supabase (managed)
services.role: PostgreSQL database, PostgREST API, Auth (GoTrue), Storage, Realtime, Edge Functions (Deno)
services.decision: Owner 2026-10-14: stay on managed Supabase; self-hosted Supabase is the drilled exit (HOSTING_DECISION_BRIEF §9, PORTABILITY.md); historical October15Denver BEYOND-01 checkpoint: private bucket/source then local/default-off/unapplied; later development catch-up is recorded in STATE and is not rechecked here; no plan/spend change. 2026-10-21 local media adapter/readers: same six buckets/services and credentials; replaceable upload/sign/list/remove and legacy/reference playback, writer switch off. No new provider, size-limit change or hosted parity claim; design/MEDIA_SERVICE_PLAN.md.

appConfig._comment: Environment variables that configure the app but name no outside service.

localLibraries._comment: Dependencies that run inside the app and call no outside service. A new dependency must be classified here or under a service.
